categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the production and sales of animal health products, including therapeutic drugs, medicated feed additives, non-medicated feed additives, and pet pharmaceuticals and health products. It serves the livestock, aquaculture, and companion animal sectors with over 300 product licenses. The business also includes contract manufacturing, distribution, and co-development collaborations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced GMP-compliant manufacturing processes with 15 dedicated production lines capable of producing powders, granules, liquids, injections, and external formulations. It employs microbial cultivation technologies for enzymes and probiotics, and integrates biochemical and nutritional science in product development. The company emphasizes WHO GMP standards and continuous process optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include poultry and livestock farms, aquaculture operators, feed mills, veterinary hospitals, and animal pharmaceutical distributors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with exports primarily to Southeast Asia, the US, and other regions. The companion animal segment targets pet owners through veterinary clinics and retail channels.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are based in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Hsinchu. The company has a strong domestic market presence and actively expands into Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas. Export sales accounted for approximately 17% of revenue, with ongoing efforts to register products in Japan and other high-regulation countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the animal health supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and product development. It sources raw materials such as antibiotics, vitamins, minerals, and enzymes from multiple international suppliers to ensure supply stability. It also engages in downstream activities including distribution and technical support services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding product diversity with a focus on green aquaculture, antibiotic alternatives like probiotics and enzymes, and companion animal health products. R&D emphasizes improving feed efficiency, enhancing animal immunity, and developing differentiated pet health solutions. The company collaborates with academic and research institutions to accelerate innovation and regulatory approvals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of animal pharmaceuticals, medicated and non-medicated feed additives, and pet health products. The company also earns income from contract manufacturing and distribution agreements. Sales channels include direct sales to farms, feed mills, veterinary clinics, and exports to international distributors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the largest animal health product manufacturer and seller in Taiwan, competing with multinational firms such as Elanco, Zoetis, Huvepharma, and Virbac, which mainly import products. Local competitors include manufacturers of vitamin and mineral premixes. The company differentiates itself through local manufacturing, extensive product range, and strong R&D capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately NT$1.29 billion, a 7.17% increase from 2023, with a net profit of NT$136.6 million, up 49.15%. The company maintains a healthy gross margin of 34.05% and a return on equity of 12.46%. It has steadily increased R&D investment and plans further growth through product development and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, safe, and environmentally friendly animal health products manufactured to human pharmaceutical standards. It offers a comprehensive product portfolio tailored to diverse animal species and customer needs, supported by strong technical services. Its green aquaculture initiatives and focus on antibiotic alternatives provide competitive differentiation aligned with regulatory trends and sustainability.
